Strict: only claims where the evidence is clear. Two AIs from different companies must agree.

Reasonable: adds claims both AIs think are probably right or wrong, though the evidence isn’t conclusive.

Speculative: also adds claims where only one AI makes a call. Treat these as guesses.

Claims are about how things are or were. Predictions are about what will happen.
